description: A department head must decide whether Lee should continue chairing the hiring panel after a tense candidate debrief, and must finalize the restorative process, communication safeguards, and review schedule.

shared_context.S1: Lee chairs the hiring panel for the customer-success team's open manager role.
shared_context.S2: After the latest candidate debrief, two panel members reported that the discussion became tense and that they were unsure how future debriefs should be handled.
shared_context.S3: Rina decides whether Lee continues as chair and what operating plan the panel will use.
shared_context.S4: As part of the department's normal review process, Rina asks each panel member and HR for their account before finalizing the plan.

PF1.text: Owen observed Lee interrupt two candidates' advocates repeatedly during the latest debrief and dismiss one concern before the advocate finished; Owen wrote these observations in his personal notes but has not submitted them to Rina.

PF2.text: Lee processes difficult feedback more reliably when it is sent in writing at least one business day before a discussion; Lee has not yet told Rina because the concern was raised privately with a peer rather than in the panel review.

PF3.text: Maya confirmed with HR this week that removing a panel chair after a documented conduct concern requires a facilitated repair meeting and a formal review exactly 30 days after the change; she has not yet added this guidance to Rina's packet.

acceptance_conditions: Lee must be removed as chair after the documented conduct concern.
Future difficult feedback must be provided in writing before any discussion.
A facilitated repair meeting must be committed to.
The formal review must occur exactly 30 days after the chair change.
The specific observation about repeated interruptions must be credited and cited by Rina.

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The two observed interruptions change the decision from leaving Lee as chair after an otherwise vague tense debrief to removing Lee and documenting a specific conduct concern.
Lee's exact need for written feedback at least one business day before discussion changes the communication safeguard from a generic conversation to written feedback before any discussion.
The confirmed HR requirement changes the follow-up from an unspecified response to a facilitated repair meeting and fixes the formal review at exactly 30 days.
